C2.question: Give me all viruses that have ineva equal to false and the abbreviation equal to BCMV.

C2.question: Give me all viruses that have ineva equal to false and the abbreviation equal to BCMV and cultivar is Saluggia or viola.

C4.question: Give me all strains that have the field 'collection' equal to '18' and that have the field 'collectiondate' with a date before '2012'.
C4.sql_query: SELECT * FROM strain WHERE collection = '18' AND ((LENGTH(collectiondate) = 10 AND SUBSTR(collectiondate, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(collectiondate, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(collectiondate, 1, 2) < '2012-01-01') OR (LENGTH(collectiondate) = 4 AND collectiondate < '2012'));

C4.question: Give me all strains that have the field 'collection' equal to '18' and that have the field 'collectiondate' with a date before '02-03-1999'.
C4.sql_query: SELECT * FROM strain WHERE collection = '18' AND ((LENGTH(collectiondate) = 10 AND SUBSTR(collectiondate, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(collectiondate, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(collectiondate, 1, 2) < '1999-03-02') OR (LENGTH(collectiondate) = 4 AND collectiondate <= '1999'));

C4.question: Give me all the strains that have the pathogenicity field equal to 'Pathogen for Plants' and that have the collectiondate field with a date after 2002.

C4.question: Give me all the strains that have the collection field equal to '18' and that have the collectiondate field with a date after '1999'. I also want the identificationtechnique to be 'ELISA' or 'Bioassay'.
C4.sql_query: SELECT * FROM strain WHERE collection = '18' AND ((LENGTH(collectiondate) = 10 AND SUBSTR(collectiondate, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(collectiondate, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(collectiondate, 1, 2) > '1999-12-31') OR (LENGTH(collectiondate) = 4 AND collectiondate > '1999')) AND (identificationtechnique = 'ELISA' OR identificationtechnique = 'Bioassay');

C4.question: Give me all the strains that have the collection field equal to 18 and that have the collectiondate field with a date between 2000 and 2010. I also want the identificationtechnique to be ELISA or Bioassay.

C5.question: Select and count the number of strains from the virus table, grouping the results by the trasmissionby field.
C5.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*), transmissionby FROM virus GROUP BY transmissionby;

C5.question: Select and count all the viruses that have the 'ineva' field equal to true and group only those that have the same storageconditions. I want you to also show me the storageconditions field.
C5.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*), storageconditions FROM virus WHERE ineva = TRUE GROUP BY storageconditions;

C5.question: Select and count the number of viruses by grouping them based on the transmissionby and storageconditions fields.
C5.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*), transmissionby, storageconditions FROM virus GROUP BY transmissionby, storageconditions;

C5.question: Select and count all viruses that have the ineva field equal to true and group only those that have the same storageconditions. I want it to also show me the storageconditions field and only the groups that have more than 4 examples.
C5.sql_query: SELECT storageconditions, COUNT(*) FROM virus WHERE ineva = TRUE GROUP BY storageconditions HAVING COUNT(*) > 4;

C6.question: Give me all the viruses that are also strains.
C6.sql_query: SELECT strain FROM virus JOIN strain ON virus.strain = strain.strainid;

C6.question: Link the 'strain' and 'virus' tables and select only the 'collectiondate' and 'transmissionby' fields.
C6.sql_query: SELECT collectiondate, transmissionby FROM strain JOIN virus ON strain.strainid = virus.strain;

C6.question: Give me all the strains that have the 'propagationhost' field equal to 'Solanaceae/Nicotiana/benthamiana'.
C6.sql_query: SELECT strainid FROM strain JOIN virus ON strain.strainid = virus.strain WHERE propagationhost = 'Solanaceae/Nicotiana/benthamiana';
